dev.openhands.installHint: RP_HOST (the URL of your ReportPortal instance) and RP_API_TOKEN (from your ReportPortal Profile page) are required. RP_PROJECT (a default project name) is optional. Requires a container runtime such as Docker.
dev.openhands.notes: Uses ReportPortal's official MCP Server, run locally as a Docker container in the default stdio mode. ReportPortal is self-hosted, so there is no public MCP endpoint; the container connects to your own instance. Provide your ReportPortal host URL and an API token from your ReportPortal Profile page.
dev.openhands.originalDescription: Query test launches, test items, history, and analysis from your ReportPortal test automation dashboard.
